english.title: Fail to comply with duty to notify registrar of change in company secretary before / upon incorporation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company to which Part 12 of the Companies Act 2006 applied and failed]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), to which Part 12 of the Companies Act 2006 applied and who was in default by failing]_

without reasonable excuse to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales that

(C)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who was named in the statement under section 12 of the Companies Act 2006 as the proposed secretary of the company, did not become the secretary upon]_
(D)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who was named in the statement under section 12 of the Companies Act 2006 as one of the proposed joint secretaries of the company, did not become one of the joint secretaries upon]_
(E)_[the required information of a proposed secretary or one of the proposed joint secretaries, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), had changed after the application for the company’s registration was delivered to the registrar, but before the]_

incorporation of the company
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 279I and 279M of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
